request: Create a lesson evaluating what changed after a notebook correction. Students must reconstruct the corrected feeding record and explain whether the water-temperature observation also changes.
objective: Apply a correction only to the statement it explicitly identifies, preserving unaffected evidence and versions.

sources.text: Fictional classroom aquarium notebook,3 March: “Tank K received six pellets at09:00. The water thermometer read21°C.”
Signed correction on4 March: “In the3 March Tank K entry, replace six pellets with four pellets; the number was copied incorrectly. All other details in that entry are unchanged.”
A separate4 March observation reads: “Tank K water22°C at09:00.” It does not correct the3 March temperature.
